kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننعمل (form VII)
# نَنْعَمِلُ (nanʕamilu) /nan.ʕa.mi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
# نَنْعَمِلَ (nanʕamila) /nan.ʕa.mi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
# نَنْعَمِلْ (nanʕamil) /nan.ʕa.mil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْعَمَلَ (inʕamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
